column1: # Coma-cluster ultra-diffuse galaxies with measured stellar velocity dispersions.
# Transcribed this session from the arXiv:2109.04487 LaTeX source of Freundlich, Famaey, Oria, Bilek, Muller &
# Ibata 2022 (A&A 658, A26), Tables 1 (sample) and 2 (accelerations at the half-light radius).
# Sources of the underlying measurements: van Dokkum et al. 2015-2019 (DF44, DFX1) and Chilingarian et al. 2019
# (Binospec spectroscopy; stellar M/L from full-spectrum SSP fits, NOT fitted to the dynamics).
# d_kpc     projected distance from the Coma centre
# dmean_kpc average 3-D distance inferred from the van der Burg+2016 Einasto radial distribution
# L_1e8     stellar luminosity (I band for DF44/DFX1, R band for the rest)
# Re_kpc    projected half-light radius;  n  Sersic index;  ML  stellar mass-to-light ratio
# sig, esig effective stellar velocity dispersion, km/s
# lgbar, elgbar, lgobs, elgobs : log10 of the baryonic and observed accelerations at the half-light radius, m/s^2
